# The session the shell guide walks through, run for real by the end-to-end
# test. A line starting with "> " is typed into the shell; the lines after it,
# up to the next "> " line, are what the shell prints. Lines starting with "#"
# are comments.
> Models()
["admin.AdminSession" "admin.AdminUser" "posts.Post"]
> Create("posts.Post", map[string]any{"Title": "Hello", "Body": "From the shell"})
map[Body:"From the shell" ID:1 Title:"Hello"]
> Create("posts.Post", map[string]any{"Title": "Draft", "Body": "Not ready"})
map[Body:"Not ready" ID:2 Title:"Draft"]
> Count("posts.Post")
2
> List("posts.Post", map[string]any{"where": map[string]any{"Title": "Hello"}, "order": []string{"-ID"}, "limit": 10})
map[Body:"From the shell" ID:1 Title:"Hello"]
> Update("posts.Post", 2, map[string]any{"Title": "Draft, revised"})
map[Body:"Not ready" ID:2 Title:"Draft, revised"]
> rows, err := List("posts.Post")
> len(rows)
2
> Delete("posts.Post", 2)
> Count("posts.Post")
1
